review_scope: Bounded Step 4 administrative Namespace Ownership / Delegation / Domain Registry review
effective_source_basis: Exact source bytes and JSON pointers in Sources.json; observed checkout commit is not a claim that every later scope-amendment file already belongs to that commit.

minimal_requirements.namespace_owner: 10/10 management owners resolve to the explicit user/project owner, not inferred from tool access alone.
minimal_requirements.roles: All eight Step 4 roles are distinguished; actual runtime actors and independent Step 9 reviewer remain separate.
minimal_requirements.delegation: All required delegator/delegatee/namespace/capability/scope/start/end/revocation/approval/prohibition fields present; all 10 groups included.
minimal_requirements.domain_registry: 8/8 domains now explicitly identify the candidate scoped governance registry and its owner/maintainer; 10 bidirectional namespace mappings resolve.
minimal_requirements.new_identity_authority: Definitions and scoped decisions belong to the owner or explicitly delegated task role; runtime grants still require their actual contract and prerequisites.
minimal_requirements.domain_lifecycle_and_identity: All 8 domains record add/modify/retire governance, stable source identifiers and historical-resolution rules; NS-C03 records cross-layer conflicts rather than inventing aliases.

direct_fix.issue: The original candidate recorded only null runtime Domain registries, leaving the distinct current governance registration location implicit.
direct_fix.resolution: Added a candidate governance register designation and reciprocal pointers; exact structure-definition sources and runtime-null fields retained.
direct_fix.activation: Only after the accepting delegate issues a digest-bound scoped Step 4 acceptance; this review does not issue it.

may_accept_routinely_under_existing_dele: The explicit user/project owner as administrative namespace and registry owner for the 10 scoped groups and 8 inherited responsibility domains.
The existing Codex task delegate as bounded maintainer, artifact publisher and accepting delegate, with inherited revocation and prerequisites.
The proposed current-task governance register and namespace/domain mappings, while preserving original definition sources.

handoff_obligations_not_step4_blockers.item: Canonical vocabulary, Domain aliases, version axes and identity/copy crosswalks; source Map labels and IMC Domain identities must not be silently equated.
Exact active program issuers, runtime readers/writers, typed consumer authorization and receipt bindings; management ownership is not proof of runtime authority.
Identify the actual independent reviewer and satisfy the dedicated evidence review contract when that review occurs.
Bind any actually needed external/private/canonical runtime registry before activating or mutating that precise namespace; do not activate speculative or retired stores just to fill cells.

constraints: No Step 4 acceptance, Freeze, migration, production mutation or Canonical service write is issued here.
The latest user scope amendment and low-cost instruction control the current scope; obsolete full-history Library prerequisites are not revived.
Source, owner, delegation or applicable scope changes invalidate the affected relationships and dependent decisions only.
